            "lineNumber": 7
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 8
          },
          {
            "text": "## 🎯 実装概要",
            "lineNumber": 9
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 10
          },
          {
            "text": "公式バージョンアップ（ReasoningEffort、RMCP 0.8.4、App Server V2 API）に伴い、zapabob独自機能を強化。Blueprint→Planリネーム、サイバーパンクUIデザイン、自然言語コマンド認識を実装。",

          {
            "lineNumber": 12

            "lineNumber": 13
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 14
          },
          {
            "text": "## ✅ 完了した実装",
            "lineNumber": 15
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 16
          },
          {
            "text": "### Phase 1-3: 公式API統合（ReasoningEffort）",
            "lineNumber": 17
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 18
          },
          {
            "text": "#### 1.1 AgentRuntime強化",
            "lineNumber": 19
          },
          {
            "text": "**ファイル**: &#96;codex-rs/core/src/agents/runtime.rs&#96;",
            "lineNumber": 20
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 21
          },
          {
            "text": "**変更内容**:",
            "lineNumber": 22
          },
          {
            "text": "- &#96;ReasoningEffort&#96;, &#96;ReasoningSummary&#96;, &#96;Verbosity&#96;フィールド追加",
            "lineNumber": 23
          },
          {
            "text": "- &#96;new()&#96;メソッドに3つのReasoning設定パラメータ追加",
            "lineNumber": 24
          },
          {
            "text": "- サブエージェント実行時にReasoning設定を適用可能に",
            "lineNumber": 25
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 26
          },
          {
            "text": "#### 1.2 ParallelOrchestrator強化",
            "lineNumber": 27
          },
          {
            "text": "**ファイル**: &#96;codex-rs/core/src/orchestration/parallel_execution.rs&#96;",
            "lineNumber": 28
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 29
          },
          {
            "text": "**変更内容**:",
            "lineNumber": 30
          },
          {
            "text": "- &#96;ReasoningConfig&#96;構造体追加",
            "lineNumber": 31
          },
          {
            "text": "- &#96;AgentTask&#96;に&#96;reasoning_effort: Option&lt;ReasoningEffort&gt;&#96;追加",
            "lineNumber": 32
          },
          {
            "text": "- &#96;ParallelOrchestrator&#96;に&#96;reasoning_config&#96;フィールド追加",
            "lineNumber": 33
          },
          {
            "text": "- &#96;with_reasoning_config()&#96;ビルダーメソッド追加",
            "lineNumber": 34
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 35
          },
          {
            "text": "#### 1.3 Session初期化での設定伝播",
            "lineNumber": 36
          },
          {
            "text": "**ファイル**: &#96;codex-rs/core/src/codex.rs&#96;",
            "lineNumber": 37
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 38
          },
          {
            "text": "**変更内容**:",
            "lineNumber": 39
          },
          {
            "text": "- &#96;AgentRuntime::new()&#96;呼び出しにReasoning設定を渡すように更新",
            "lineNumber": 40
          },
          {
            "text": "- &#96;config.model_reasoning_effort&#96;, &#96;config.model_reasoning_summary&#96;, &#96;config.model_verbosity&#96;を使用",
            "lineNumber": 41
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 42
          },
          {
            "text": "#### 1.4 全呼び出し箇所の更新",

          },

          },

          {
            "text": "## [2.0.0] - 2025-11-06",
            "lineNumber": 313
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 314
          },
          {
            "text": "### 🎊 MAJOR RELEASE - Revolutionary GPU Acceleration &amp; Kamui4D-Exceeding Visualization",
            "lineNumber": 315
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 316
          },
          {
            "text": "This is a **major version release** with significant architectural changes and new capabilities:",
            "lineNumber": 317
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 318
          },
          {
            "text": "### Added - Revolutionary GPU Acceleration &amp; Kamui4D-Exceeding Visualization",
            "lineNumber": 319
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 320
          },
          {
            "text": "**Windows AI Integration**",
            "lineNumber": 321
          },
          {
            "text": "- Windows 11 AI API integration (DirectML) for OS-level optimization",
            "lineNumber": 322
          },
          {
            "text": "- Kernel driver acceleration for AI workloads (40-60% faster inference)",
            "lineNumber": 323
          },
          {
            "text": "- Hybrid acceleration layer (Windows AI + CUDA)",
            "lineNumber": 324
          },
          {
            "text": "- CLI flags: &#96;--use-windows-ai&#96;, &#96;--kernel-accelerated&#96;",
            "lineNumber": 325
          },
          {
            "text": "- GPU statistics API and kernel bridge",
            "lineNumber": 326
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 327
          },
          {
            "text": "**CUDA Complete Integration**",
            "lineNumber": 328
          },
          {
            "text": "- CUDA Runtime integration using Rust-CUDA (&#96;cust&#96; crate)",
            "lineNumber": 329
          },
          {
            "text": "- GPU-accelerated git analysis (100-1000x faster)",
            "lineNumber": 330
          },
          {
            "text": "- MCP tool for CUDA execution (&#96;codex_cuda_execute&#96;)",
            "lineNumber": 331
          },
          {
            "text": "- CLI flags: &#96;--use-cuda&#96;, &#96;--cuda-device &lt;ID&gt;&#96;",
            "lineNumber": 332
          },
          {
            "text": "- Supports 100,000+ commits analysis",
            "lineNumber": 333
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 334
          },
          {
            "text": "**3D/4D Git Visualization - Kamui4D超え**",
            "lineNumber": 335
          },
          {
            "text": "- TUI 3D ASCII git visualizer with CUDA acceleration",
            "lineNumber": 336
          },
          {
            "text": "- CLI &#96;git-analyze visualize-3d&#96; command with JSON export",
            "lineNumber": 337
          },
          {
            "text": "- GUI CUDA integration with real-time GPU stats",
            "lineNumber": 338
          },
          {
            "text": "- 120fps sustained rendering (4x faster than Kamui4D)",
            "lineNumber": 339
          },
          {
            "text": "- Spiral pattern visualization with change-based height",
            "lineNumber": 340
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 341
          },
          {
            "text": "**New Commands**",
            "lineNumber": 342
          },
          {
            "text": "- &#96;codex git-analyze commits --use-cuda&#96; - CUDA-accelerated commit analysis",
            "lineNumber": 343
          },
          {
            "text": "- &#96;codex git-analyze visualize-3d&#96; - Launch 3D visualization",
            "lineNumber": 344
          },
          {
            "text": "- &#96;codex git-analyze visualize-3d --export-json&#96; - Export 3D data for GUI",
            "lineNumber": 345
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 346
          },
          {
            "text": "### Changed",
            "lineNumber": 347
          },
          {
            "text": "- **MAJOR VERSION BUMP**: 0.47.0 → **2.0.0** (Breaking: New architecture, feature gates, GPU acceleration)",

          },
          {
            "text": "- **GUI Version**: 1.4.0 → **2.0.0** (Unified with workspace version)",

          },
          {

          },

          },
          {

      "codeBlock": {
        "relativeWorkspacePath": ".\\docs\\architecture\\cli-architecture.md",
        "range": {

        "signatures": {},
        "detailedLines": [
          {
            "text": "# 🎯 Codex CLI-First Architecture",
            "lineNumber": 1
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 2
          },
          {
            "text": "**Design Philosophy**: All model selection and configuration flows through Codex CLI  ",
            "lineNumber": 3
          },
          {
            "text": "**Date**: 2025-10-13  ",
            "lineNumber": 4
          },
          {
            "text": "**Version**: 0.47.0-alpha.1",
            "lineNumber": 5
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 6
          },
          {
            "text": "---",
            "lineNumber": 7
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 8
          },
          {
            "text": "## 🌟 Core Concept",
            "lineNumber": 9
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 10
          },
          {
            "text": "**Single Source of Truth**: Codex CLI の &#96;--model&#96; オプションが唯一のモデル選択方法",
            "lineNumber": 11
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 12
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;",
            "lineNumber": 13
          },
          {
            "text": "User → Codex CLI (--model) → All Features",
            "lineNumber": 14
          },
          {
            "text": "                │",
            "lineNumber": 15
          },
          {
            "text": "                ├─→ Direct Execution",
            "lineNumber": 16
          },
          {
            "text": "                ├─→ MCP Server (for Cursor IDE)",
            "lineNumber": 17
          },
          {
            "text": "                ├─→ Subagents (via MCP)",
            "lineNumber": 18
          },
          {
            "text": "                └─→ Deep Research (via MCP)",
            "lineNumber": 19
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;",
            "lineNumber": 20
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 21
          },
          {
            "text": "---",
            "lineNumber": 22
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 23
          },
          {
            "text": "## ✅ Design Principles",
            "lineNumber": 24
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 25
          },
          {
            "text": "### 1. CLI-First",
            "lineNumber": 26
          },
          {
            "text": "- **モデルは CLI 実行時に指定**",
            "lineNumber": 27
          },
          {
            "text": "- 設定ファイルでモデルを固定**しない**",
            "lineNumber": 28
          },
          {
            "text": "- 柔軟性と明示性を重視",
            "lineNumber": 29
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 30
          },
          {
            "text": "### 2. MCP-Based Integration",
            "lineNumber": 31
          },
          {
            "text": "- Codex 自身を MCP サーバーとして登録",
            "lineNumber": 32
          },
          {
            "text": "- Subagents, Deep Research, Custom Commands 全てを MCP 経由で実現",
            "lineNumber": 33
          },
          {
            "text": "- 統一されたインターフェース",
            "lineNumber": 34
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 35
          },
          {
            "text": "### 3. No Model Hardcoding",
            "lineNumber": 36
          },
          {
            "text": "- &#96;config.toml&#96; にモデル指定なし（オプション）",
            "lineNumber": 37
          },
          {
            "text": "- &#96;mcp.json&#96; にモデル環境変数なし",
            "lineNumber": 38
          },
          {
            "text": "- 全てランタイムで決定",
            "lineNumber": 39
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 40
          },
          {
            "text": "---",
            "lineNumber": 41
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 42
          },
          {
            "text": "## 📝 Configuration Files",
            "lineNumber": 43
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 44
          },
          {
            "text": "### config.toml (Minimal Configuration)",
            "lineNumber": 45
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 46
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;toml",
            "lineNumber": 47
          },
          {
            "text": "# Codex Configuration",
            "lineNumber": 48
          },
          {
            "text": "# サブエージェント用の設定",
            "lineNumber": 49
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 50
          },
          {
            "text": "# モデル設定",
            "lineNumber": 51
          },
          {
            "text": "# 注意: モデルは CLI 実行時に --model オプションで指定してください",
            "lineNumber": 52
          },
          {
            "text": "# デフォルト値を設定したい場合のみ、以下のコメントを外してください",
            "lineNumber": 53
          },
          {
            "text": "# model = \"gpt-4o\"  # 例: デフォルトモデル",
            "lineNumber": 54
          },
          {
            "text": "model_reasoning_summary = \"detailed\"",
            "lineNumber": 55
          },
          {
            "text": "windows_wsl_setup_acknowledged = true",
            "lineNumber": 56
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 57
          },
          {
            "text": "# OpenAI Provider設定",
            "lineNumber": 58
          },
          {
            "text": "[model_providers.openai]",
            "lineNumber": 59
          },
          {
            "text": "base_url = \"https://api.openai.com/v1\"",
            "lineNumber": 60
          },
          {
            "text": "env_key = \"OPENAI_API_KEY\"",
            "lineNumber": 61
          },
          {
            "text": "name = \"OpenAI (Chat Completions API)\"",
            "lineNumber": 62
          },
          {
            "text": "requires_openai_auth = true",
            "lineNumber": 63
          },
          {
            "text": "wire_api = \"chat\"",
            "lineNumber": 64
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 65
          },
          {
            "text": "# MCP Servers Configuration",
            "lineNumber": 66
          },
          {
            "text": "[mcp_servers.codex-agent]",
            "lineNumber": 67
          },
          {
            "text": "args = [\"mcp-server\"]",
            "lineNumber": 68
          },
          {
            "text": "command = \"codex\"",
            "lineNumber": 69
          },
          {
            "text": "env.CODEX_CONFIG_PATH = \"C:\\\\Users\\\\downl\\\\.codex\\\\config.toml\"",
            "lineNumber": 70
          },
          {
            "text": "env.RUST_LOG = \"info\"",
            "lineNumber": 71
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;",
            "lineNumber": 72
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 73
          },
          {
            "text": "**Key Points**:",
            "lineNumber": 74
          }
        ]
      },
      "score": 0.37277114391326904

          {
            "text": "# 2025-10-24 Codex v0.49.0-zapabob.1 リリース",
            "lineNumber": 1
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 2
          },
          {
            "text": "## 🎯 リリースサマリー",
            "lineNumber": 3
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 4
          },
          {
            "text": "**バージョン**: 0.48.0-zapabob.1 → **0.49.0-zapabob.1**  ",
            "lineNumber": 5
          },
          {
            "text": "**リリース日**: 2025-10-24  ",
            "lineNumber": 6
          },
          {
            "text": "**戦略**: 独自機能保護型アップグレード  ",
            "lineNumber": 7
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 8
          },
          {
            "text": "## 📊 主な変更点",
            "lineNumber": 9
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 10
          },
          {
            "text": "### ✅ セマンティックバージョンアップ",
            "lineNumber": 11
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 12
          },
          {
            "text": "- **旧バージョン**: 0.48.0-zapabob.1",
            "lineNumber": 13
          },
          {
            "text": "- **新バージョン**: 0.49.0-zapabob.1",
            "lineNumber": 14
          },
          {
            "text": "- **変更理由**: マイナーバージョンアップ（新機能追加・統合テスト完了）",
            "lineNumber": 15
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 16
          },
          {
            "text": "### 🔄 OpenAI公式との整合性",
            "lineNumber": 17
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 18
          },
          {
            "text": "**フェッチ結果**:",
            "lineNumber": 19
          },
          {
            "text": "- upstream/main: 88abbf58 (Followup feedback #5663)",
            "lineNumber": 20
          },
          {
            "text": "- zapabob/main: e696a325 (specstory history更新)",
            "lineNumber": 21
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 22
          },
          {
            "text": "**マージ戦略**: **独自機能保護**",
            "lineNumber": 23
          },
          {
            "text": "- 公式の最新（88abbf58）をフェッチ",
            "lineNumber": 24
          },
          {
            "text": "- zapabob独自機能を完全保持",
            "lineNumber": 25
          },
          {
            "text": "- コンフリクトなし（独自実装を優先）",
            "lineNumber": 26
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 27
          },
          {
            "text": "**理由**:",
            "lineNumber": 28
          },
          {
            "text": "- zapabobは独自機能が多数（Deep Research, Gemini MCP, Orchestration等）",
            "lineNumber": 29
          },
          {
            "text": "- 公式との直接マージはリスクが高い",
            "lineNumber": 30
          },
          {
            "text": "- 安定性を最優先",
            "lineNumber": 31
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 32
          },
          {
            "text": "### 🚀 zapabob独自機能（保護済み）",
            "lineNumber": 33
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 34
          },
          {
            "text": "#### 1. Deep Research機能",
            "lineNumber": 35
          },
          {
            "text": "**ディレクトリ**: &#96;codex-rs/deep-research/&#96;",
            "lineNumber": 36

          {
            "text": "# Codex v2.11.0 - ClaudeCode Integration Release",

          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 2
          },
          {
            "text": "## 🎯 Release Overview",
            "lineNumber": 3
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 4
          },
          {
            "text": "**Codex v2.11.0 \"ClaudeCode Integration\"** represents the ultimate evolution of AI-assisted development, completely integrating ClaudeCode's revolutionary features while eliminating its fundamental limitations.",
            "lineNumber": 5
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 6
          },
          {
            "text": "## ✅ ClaudeCode Features Inherited (The Good Parts)",

          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 8
          },
          {
            "text": "### 🗣️ Natural Language Task Specification",

          },
          {

          },
          {
            "text": "- Error handling and validation",
            "lineNumber": 18
          },
          {
            "text": "- Code structure optimization",
            "lineNumber": 19
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 20
          },
          {
            "text": "### 🖥️ Terminal Integration",
            "lineNumber": 21
          },
          {

            "lineNumber": 22
          },
          {
            "text": "- Git operations and version control",
            "lineNumber": 23
          },
          {
            "text": "- Package management integration",
            "lineNumber": 24
          },
          {

            "lineNumber": 25
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 26
          },
          {
            "text": "### 🔌 MCP Protocol Support",

          },
          {

          },
          {
            "text": "- Plugin architecture",

          },
          {

          },
          {

          },
          {

          },
          {

          },

          },
          {

          },
          {

          },

          },

            "lineNumber": 43
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 44
          },
          {
            "text": "## ❌ ClaudeCode Problems Solved (The Bad Parts)",
            "lineNumber": 45
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 46
          },
          {
            "text": "### 🔄 Multi-Model Support",
            "lineNumber": 47
          },
          {
            "text": "- **Gemini Pro &amp; Pro Vision**: Advanced multimodal capabilities",

          },
          {
            "text": "- **Claude 3 Opus/Sonnet/Haiku**: Balanced reasoning and creativity",

          },
          {
            "text": "- **GPT-4 Turbo &amp; GPT-4**: Broad knowledge and consistency",

          },
          {
            "text": "- **Local Models**: Llama 3, Code Llama, DeepSeek for privacy",

          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 52
          },
          {
            "text": "### 💰 Intelligent Cost Optimization",

          },
          {

          },
          {

          },
          {
            "text": "#### 2. 自動オーケストレーション 🤖",

          {

            "lineNumber": 108
          },
          {

          },

          },

          },

          },
          {

          },

          },
          {
            "text": "**実装内容**:",
            "lineNumber": 21
          },
          {

            "lineNumber": 22
          },
          {
            "text": "- QCエージェントが他のエージェント（Codex, GeminiCLI等）と並列実行可能に",
            "lineNumber": 23

          },

            "lineNumber": 25
          },
          {

            "lineNumber": 26
          },
          {
            "text": "#[serde(rename_all = \"lowercase\")]",
            "lineNumber": 27
          },
          {
            "text": "pub enum AgentType {",
            "lineNumber": 28
          },
          {
            "text": "    Codex,",
            "lineNumber": 29
          },
          {

          },

          },

          },
          {

            "lineNumber": 34
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 35
          },
          {
            "text": "### 2. QCエージェント実行ロジック実装",
            "lineNumber": 36
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 37
          },

            "lineNumber": 38
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 39
          },
          {
            "text": "**実装内容**:",
            "lineNumber": 40
          },
          {
            "text": "- &#96;run_qc_agent&#96;メソッドを追加",
            "lineNumber": 41
          },
          {
            "text": "- &#96;QcAgent::analyze()&#96;を呼び出してコード品質分析を実行",
            "lineNumber": 42
          },

          },
          {

          {

            "lineNumber": 47
          },

            "lineNumber": 48
          },
          {

          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 50
          },

            "text": "---",
            "lineNumber": 188
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 189
          },
          {
            "text": "## 🚀 主要機能",
            "lineNumber": 190
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 191
          },
          {
            "text": "### QCエージェントの並列実行",
            "lineNumber": 192
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 193
          },
          {
            "text": "- **中央集権型**: 他のエージェントの結果を分析",
            "lineNumber": 194
          },
          {
            "text": "- **並列開発型**: 各worktreeのコードを分析",
            "lineNumber": 195
          },
          {
            "text": "- **分析内容**:",
            "lineNumber": 196
          },
          {
            "text": "  - 統計分析（コード統計、品質指標）",
            "lineNumber": 197
          },
          {
            "text": "  - 量子最適化（最適化提案、改善ポテンシャル）",
            "lineNumber": 198
          },
          {
            "text": "  - 数理最適化（リソース割り当て、ボトルネック分析）",
            "lineNumber": 199
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 200
          },
          {
            "text": "### 品質スコアベースの選択",
            "lineNumber": 201
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 202
          },
          {
            "text": "**品質スコアの計算**:",
            "lineNumber": 203
          },
          {
            "text": "- **可読性**: コード密度、関数サイズ",
            "lineNumber": 204
          },
          {
            "text": "- **保守性**: 複雑度、インポート効率",
            "lineNumber": 205
          },
          {
            "text": "- **パフォーマンス**: 最適化ポテンシャル",
            "lineNumber": 206
          },
          {
            "text": "- **セキュリティ**: リソース最適化スコア",
            "lineNumber": 207
          },
          {
            "text": "- **総合スコア**: 上記4つの平均",
            "lineNumber": 208
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 209
          },
          {
            "text": "**選択アルゴリズム**:",
            "lineNumber": 210
          },
          {
            "text": "1. 各エージェント/worktreeのコードをQC分析",
            "lineNumber": 211
          },
          {
            "text": "2. 品質スコアを計算",
            "lineNumber": 212
          },
          {
            "text": "3. 総合スコアが最も高いものを選択",
            "lineNumber": 213
          },
          {
            "text": "4. マージ決定をログに記録",
            "lineNumber": 214
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 215
          },
          {
            "text": "### QC結果のログ記録",
            "lineNumber": 216
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 217
          },
          {
            "text": "**ログ内容**:",
            "lineNumber": 218
          },
          {
            "text": "- QC分析レポート",
            "lineNumber": 219
          },
          {
            "text": "  - 品質スコア（総合、可読性、保守性、パフォーマンス、セキュリティ）",
            "lineNumber": 220
          }
        ]
      },
